decision: umn_ext 'Growing pumpkins and winter squash': "Plant pumpkin and winter squash seeds three-fourths of an inch deep, 24 to 36 inches apart. Use the closer spacing if the variety is a bush type. Spacing between rows should be 5 to 6 feet." -> row-none default, in_row [24,36], rows [60,72] (today [24,72]). D1 BLEND REPAIR (ruled): today's [24,72] joins UMN's in-row lo (24) to its between-row hi (72; the 2026-07-01 note: 'spans in-row plant spacing (24 in) to row spacing (72 in)'). UMN names winter squash; in-row [24,36], rows [60,72], which is exactly the crop's own soil_prep prose. Bush (Butterbush) is D2. Every restatement already agrees. No hill entry: the only hill figure on its cited pages is UGA C1206, a PUMPKIN page ('Plant pumpkins in hills, with at least 8 feet of space on all sides'), out of scope (worklist 56 §3).

in_row_inches.quote: Plant pumpkin and winter squash seeds three-fourths of an inch deep, 24 to 36 inches apart.
